# Vault index

Load this file, pick the files whose **read-when** matches your task, and load only those.
Writing rules: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Status: `done` = reviewed and final,
`draft` = written but not reviewed, `todo` = planned.

## Trends (generated by tools/trends, never hand-edit)

The trends report is your own data, so it is not part of the tracked tree. `tools/trends` writes
it to `private/trends/latest.md`, with dated copies in `private/trends/history/`.

| File | Read when | If it is missing |
|---|---|---|
| `private/trends/latest.md` | Choosing a game idea, judging saturation, or citing what's popular now. | Say so, then either run `collect` and `report` (tools/trends/README.md) or continue without market numbers and say that in the output. |

## Case studies (private notes)

Case studies of named games are personal research notes. They are kept in
`private/case-studies/<slug>.md`, listed in `private/case-studies/INDEX.md`, and follow the same
writing rules (CONTRIBUTING.md). Vault files point at one as `(case study: <slug>)`.

If `private/case-studies/` is missing, skip the case study and say so: the genre file's
"Top examples" section still carries the one-line summary of each game.
